query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T09:20:52Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T09:24:52Z"
  AND host.name == "db-1"
  AND process.name == "sshd"
  AND event.outcome == "failure"
| KEEP @timestamp, source.ip, source.port, user.name, message
| SORT @timestamp ASC
| LIMIT 20
